chroma_key.name: magenta
chroma_key.selection_reason: the base reference yielded no subject pixels once its background was excluded

play.action: four-frame one-shot withdrawal, designed for immediate readability over a #10131c game screen: frame 1 shows a connected branching crack network across the upper 55% of the frame; frames 2 and 3 spread it wider and pull its pale light upward; frame 4 leaves a broad jagged network spanning at least 70% of the width. Main branches have fully opaque ivory-orange cores 18-36 pixels thick and secondary branches 10-18 pixels thick, with a crisp dark-red rim. No hairlines, isolated tiny cracks, faint gray marks, or translucent-only light. Keep the lower 35% and a clear central play area empty.

style: bold high-contrast branching crack effect matching the accepted base image; thick fully opaque ivory-orange cores with a crisp dark-red rim, clean hard edges, no pixel art, no palette reduction
